newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Workers Party wants re-election referendum.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Workers Party wants re-election referendum.

text.p: Brazil's left-wing Workers Party (PT) has formally suggested that a proposed reform of the constitution to allow re-election be put to a national referendum, a PT spokesman said.
Party leaders gathered the 141 signatures of deputies needed to present the proposed alteration to a lower house panel which was set up on Tuesday to mull re-election, the spokesman said.

The chairman of the panel may opt to include the proposal in a draft version of the re-election bill or reject it. If the proposal is rejected, the PT will present it again when the bill reaches the floor of the lower house, the spokesman said.
However, the PT, which has likened President Fernando Henrique Cardoso's plan to a modern-day coup, recognized the referendum idea stood little chance of being approved.
